meaning:
ὑπερ-βαίνω
[in LXX for עָבַר, etc. ;]
1. trans., to step over, trans­gress (R, overreach: 1Th.4:6).
2. Intrans., to transgress: metaphorically, 1Th.4:6 (R, txt.; see M, Th., in l).†
(AS)

elsewhere.note: that no one should take advantage of and wrong a brother or sister in this matter; because the Lord is an avenger in all these things, as also we forewarned…
